import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long INV = 570000004L;
    static final int MN = 22;

    static int n;
    static long[][] p = new long[MN][MN];
    static int[][] permsA = new int[MN][3];
    static int[][] permsB = new int[MN][3];
    static long[] bmA = new long[1 << MN];
    static long[] bmB = new long[1 << MN];
    static long[] f = new long[1 << MN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        
        int t = 0;
        int[] aah = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
        do {
            if (aah[0] < aah[1] && aah[1] < aah[2] && aah[3] < aah[4] && aah[4] < aah[5]) {
                permsA[t][0] = aah[0];
                permsA[t][1] = aah[1];
                permsA[t][2] = aah[2];
                permsB[t][0] = aah[3];
                permsB[t][1] = aah[4];
                permsB[t][2] = aah[5];
                t++;
            }
        } while (nextPermutation(aah));
        
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                p[i][j] = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (p[i][j] * INV) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = n; j < 6; ++j) {
                if (i == j) p[i][j] = 1;
                else { p[i][j] = 0; p[j][i] = 0; }
            }
        }
        n = 6;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); ++i) {
            long prob1 = 1;
            long prob2 = 1;
            int bm1 = 0;
            int bm2 = 0;
            
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
                    int res = j * 3 + k;
                    if ((1 << res) & i) {
                        prob1 = (prob1 * p[j][k]) % MOD;
                        prob2 = (prob2 * p[j][k + 3]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prob1 = (prob1 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k])) % MOD;
                        prob2 = (prob2 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k + 3])) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int ot = 0; ot < 20; ++ot) {
                int[] ord = {0, 1, 2};
                boolean ok = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok2 = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
                        int val = permsA[ot][ord[j]];
                        int loc = val * 3 + j;
                        if (((1 << loc) & i) == 0) {
                            ok2 = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok2) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(ord));
                if (ok) {
                    bm1 ^= (1 << ot);
                }
            }
            
            for (int ot = 0; ot < 20; ++ot) {
                int[] ord = {0, 1, 2};
                boolean ok = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok2 = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
                        int val = permsB[ot][ord[j]];
                        int loc = val * 3 + j;
                        if (((1 << loc) & i) == 0) {
                            ok2 = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok2) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(ord));
                if (ok) {
                    bm2 ^= (1 << ot);
                }
            }
            
            bmA[bm1] = (bmA[bm1] + prob1) % MOD;
            bmB[bm2] = (bmB[bm2] + prob2) % MOD;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) {
            f[i] = bmA[i];
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f[mask] += f[mask ^ (1 << i)];
                    f[mask] %= MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        long sm = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) {
            int o = (1 << 20) - 1;
            sm = (sm + bmB[i] * f[o ^ i]) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println((1 + MOD - sm) % MOD);
    }
    
    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr) {
        int i = arr.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = arr.length - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
        
        reverse(arr, i + 1, arr.length - 1);
        return true;
    }
    
    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = arr[start];
            arr[start] = arr[end];
            arr[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }
}
